title: AG: RMV employee accepted cash payments to expedite service, bypass requirements
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Crime Income from the bribery scheme allegedly exceeded the woman's income as a salaried RMV employee, the attorney general said.
A former Registry of Motor Vehicles employee has been charged with running a scheme in which she accepted bribes in exchange for expedited services.

Ashlee Jordan, 29, of Bridgewater, a former RMV title clerk at the Quincy headquarters, was charged with one count of bribery, one count of unwarranted privilege, and one count of conspiracy to commit title fraud, the Massachusetts Attorney General’s Office said in a release.
